title: Hosted endpoint territory-lock wizard and retention-proof exports
creator: Samira Khan
description:
Problem statement:
Customers operating under regulatory or contractual constraints need an easy, auditable way to pin hosted API endpoints to specific geographic territories (regions/zones) and to assert retention policies for the data persisted in those requests. Today we have ad-hoc residency knobs but no single guided flow that combines: territory selection, retention TTLs for request/response artifacts, and an automated evidence export that auditors can consume. This ticket scopes a product-led feature: a guided 'Territory Lock' wizard in the Console + a companion managed evidence export (signed bundle, provenance metadata, and retention proof) that can be scheduled or generated on-demand for audits.

Goals:
- Offer a stepwise wizard to declare an endpoint's territory constraints and retention profile in the Console and via API.
- Provide fine-grained retention settings: ephemeral (24h), short (30d), standard (365d), custom (ISO-8601 duration), and customer-managed retention override for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Attach a verifiable evidence export to the endpoint: signed manifest with active routing policy, region assignments, effective model variant, retention TTLs, and audit logs covering access and policy changes.
- Surface drift alerts if runtime routing deviates from the declared territory for >5 minutes.
- Make the evidence export machine-readable (JSON + gz) and human-friendly (PDF summary) with checksums and a signed attestations field.

Scope (in):
- Console wizard flows for creating/updating territory lock & retention profile on hosted endpoints.
- API endpoints to set/get territory and retention config on an endpoint.
- Evidence export generation API and Console action; scheduled exports (daily/weekly) and on-demand export.
- Backend plumbing to record and snapshot routing decisions, region assignment history, and retention configurations.
- Telemetry to track drift, export generation, and customer download events.

Non-goals (out of scope):
- Dedicated capacity-specific RBAC flows (handled in separate Dedicated tickets).
- On-prem installation packaging and HSM-based signing (later phase).

User flows:
1) PM/engineer creates an endpoint in Console -> clicks "Configure territory & retention" -> chooses territory (region or set of regions), pin priority (strict, soft, soft-failover), retention profile, and whether evidence exports should be scheduled.
2) Operator can view current active routing snapshot and request an on-demand evidence export.
3) Audit team receives an evidence bundle (signed) with manifest + routing timeline + retention assertions + a PDF summary.

API contract (high level):
- POST /v1/endpoints/{id}/territory-config {territory: [region_ids], pin_mode: "strict|soft|soft-failover", retention: {type: "preset|custom", value: "P30D"}}
- GET /v1/endpoints/{id}/evidence?since=2026-01-01&format=json|pdf&scope=full|manifest
- POST /v1/endpoints/{id}/evidence/generate {schedule: "none|daily|weekly", include_logs: true}

Evidence bundle contents (minimum):
- manifest.json: endpoint id, version, declared territory, pin_mode, retention_profile, creation timestamp, signatures
- routing_timeline.json.gz: time-series of routing decisions (region chosen, reason, fallback) covering the requested window
- retention_proof.json: list of TTLs associated with persisted artifacts and who changed them
- access_audit.log.gz: auth events and export downloads
- summary.pdf: human-readable summary and attestations

Acceptance criteria:
- Console wizard implemented and QA'd behind feature flag for 10 pilot tenants.
- API endpoints pass contract tests and 2 integration tests exercising scheduled export and on-demand generation.
- Evidence bundle includes signed manifest and routing_timeline for the requested window.
- Drift alerts fire when routing deviates from declared territory > 5 minutes; alert shows in Console and emits telemetry event.
- All new telemetry and audit events are captured in telemetry dashboard.

Operational runbook (short):
- If evidence export fails: check export worker logs (ENG task ENG-17892), verify S3/GCS retention policy and signer availability, re-run with on-demand flag.
- If drift alert spikes: validate gating config in routing layer, examine region health and autoscaler logs, fallback model variant audit.

Metrics to monitor:
- evidence.generate.success_rate
- evidence.generate.latency
- territory.lock.count
- territory.drift.alerts_per_hour
- user.downloads.evidence_bundle

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Signing model: cloud-signer vs customer-signer (phase 1 = cloud-signer with strong provenance).
- PDF vs standardized schema for third-party auditors; we will provide both (JSON canonical + PDF summary).
- Retention enforcement vs statement-of-truth: hosted will implement soft enforcement (we garbage collect according to TTLs but will not encrypt-delete for customers with legal holds in first release).

References/links: See attachments below for design mockups and compliance brief.
updates: 2026-02-20: Kickoff aligned with Eng (routing/runtime), Security, and Legal. Decided feature flag gating with pilot tenants.
2026-02-25: Design review completed — updated wizard to surface 'pin strictness' and fallback policy with examples. Design asked for clearer language around 'soft-failover'.
2026-03-02: ENG-17892 created to implement routing snapshot store; ENG-18210 tracking evidence export worker. Assigned initial API contract to ENG.
2026-03-08: Security requested proof of signer key rotation in export manifest. Added signer rotation note to evidence manifest spec.
2026-03-10: Prototype export generation PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7876 — backend produces manifest + gzipped timeline. Need PDF templating work (design and eng).

2026-03-13: Internal pilot tenant (acme-fin) enabled behind flag; first scheduled export succeeded (attach link in Slack). Observing small latency blips when compressing large timelines; engineering to profile compressor settings.
acceptance_criteria: Console wizard available behind feature-flag and completes territory+retention setup without errors.
API endpoints respond with 200/validation errors per contract; integration tests green in CI.
Evidence bundle includes manifest + routing_timeline + retention_proof and is signed; checksum validated by download flow.
Drift alerts are emitted and visible in Console; telemetry counters increment as expected.
Documentation (Console help + API spec) published in Confluence and referenced from Console UI.
test_plan: Unit tests for API validation (territory set validation, retention duration parsing).
Integration test that sets territory, simulates routing decisions across regions, and generates an evidence bundle; assert manifest fields and signature.
E2E pilot with 2 tenants for 2 weeks capturing scheduled export stability and drift alerts.
Security review of manifest signing and signer rotation mechanism.
risks: Large routing timelines can produce heavy export payloads and slow generation — mitigation: limit window or implement incremental exports.
Customers may expect cryptographic guarantees for deletion; initial release only provides retention enforcement under our hosted garbage collection policy.
Misconfiguration could cause accidental soft-failover to other regions; default pin_mode = strict for tenants opting into compliance.
